cd /challenge/inhere

for f in $(find . -type f | sort); do

    00) exp="zeros";;

  if [ "$exp" = "zeros" ]; then

    if [ "$(tr -d 'x' < "$f" | wc -c)" != "0" ]; then echo "DIFF: $f not all x"; fi

    # check all lines are "record $area-$item"
    bad=$(grep -vc "^record $area-$item\$" "$f")
    if [ "$bad" != "0" ]; then echo "DIFF: $f has $bad non-matching lines"; fi
  fi
done
echo "scan complete"
